new_result.statement: For A=R^T Lambda R of rank r>=3 with RR^T=I, max_j ||R^TR e_j||_2<=1/2 and D=(prod |lambda_k|)^(1/r)>0, independent input densities <=1 give a continuous Q-density with ||p_Q||_inf <= B^2 r/(4 pi^2 D (r-2)); if D>=1 this is <=3B^2/(4pi^2).
new_result.stress_test: For the rank-three Walsh projection, ||P e_j||=sqrt(3/n), so every Walsh size n>=16 is covered uniformly.
